Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — a record's actions | 缺项 | P3

## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue`. Direction: the four `action:*` renderers explain a predicate-disabled control the same way #11811 does; claim after #11811 lands

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T23:53Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/components/src/renderers/action/` (`action-button.tsx`, `action-icon.tsx`, `action-group.tsx`, `action-menu.tsx`, read on objectui `main` `16cda0bf35`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: the published component renderers in objectui.

- **Why p3:** it is the same consequence as #11811 (p3): the action is correctly disabled, and the user cannot learn why. The reach is a named producer, the showcase's `disabled`-predicate specimen.
- **Direction:**
  - each renderer gives a predicate-disabled control the reason that #11811 adds: a tooltip on hover and focus through a focusable wrapper, since the `Button` primitive's `disabled:pointer-events-none` swallows a `title`, plus an accessible description with the same i18n key;
  - a loading-disabled or host-disabled control is unchanged.
- **The shared helper:** the wrapper would then have three local copies. Making it one helper inside a package is the claimant's call. Exporting it from `@object-ui/components` widens the public surface, so name it with `Clause-②: yes` if taken.
- **Pins per renderer:** predicate true shows the reason on hover and focus; controls are predicate false and loading.
- **Serial:** after #11811 (dispatched), so its key and pattern exist on `main`. This is the family's second member.
- `Clause-②: no`, unless the helper is exported. Patch changeset in objectui.

Claim: PM loop round 3

⛔ Not on it: `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (objectui#11811's copy stays where it is), `packages/app-shell/**`, `packages/plugin-detail/**`, and the language packs (the key `actions.notAvailableForRecord` already ships in every pack). Any file outside this list: the dev reports it before opening the PR (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui`: no path-derived mandate; default tier)

Responsibility: `objectui components: the four action:* renderers grey out an action whose declared disabled predicate is true and give no reason | the platform path: objectui#11811 already shipped the reason, its key and its focusable-wrapper pattern for the record header, the section bar and DeclaredActionsBar | every end user meeting a predicate-disabled action drawn by these renderers, starting with the showcase's showcase_archive_task specimen`

Serial constraints cleared: objectui#11811 (the predecessor the card and triage name) merged as `455c646` and is closed, so its key and pattern are on `main`. No in-flight claim in the lane names `packages/components/src/renderers/action/`, and no open objectui PR touches it (read 2026-10-08T01:23Z). No other `area:records` card is in flight.

Why `Clause-②: no`: the shared helper stays inside `@object-ui/components` and reuses the shipped key. Exporting the helper, adding a prop to a published type or adding a language-pack key is a stop: the dev reports it before opening the PR, and the seat amends this line.

ACCEPT — `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`, 2026-10-08T02:55Z. PR objectui#11867, head `01d1300`.

- **PR shape:** draft against `main`, branched from `59ce048`, no rebase. `git merge-tree` of the current `main` (`4e7dd56`) and this head is clean; the queue tests that merge. First line `Fixes #11839`, no other closing keyword. `Clause-②: no` at line start. The five commits carry only the model-free trailer pair. Assigned to `os-support-ai`.
- **Scope:** 8 files, +611/−6, all on the claim's surface (`6050241918`) under `packages/components/src/renderers/action/`:
  - the four renderers;
  - one new module-private helper, `disabled-reason.tsx`;
  - a new pin file and the adapted `__tests__/action-bar-member-placement-10345.test.tsx`;
  - the changeset (`patch` on `@object-ui/components`).

  `containers.tsx`, app-shell, plugin-detail and the language packs are untouched. The dev measured that the helper is not reached from the built `dist/index.d.ts`: 101 files are reached, `disabled-reason.d.ts` is not, and the controls `visibility-gate.d.ts` and `resolve-icon.d.ts` are. No governed path.
- **Diff read (the seat's own):**
  - Each renderer calls `useDisabledReason(hasDeclaredVisibilityGate(<declared disabled>) && <its predicate verdict>)`. In `action:button` that verdict is `isDisabled`, which is `useCondition(schema.disabled)` alone; elsewhere it is `isDisabledPred`. So `hostDisabled`, `loading` and the legacy `enabled` leg earn no reason.
  - Buttons (`action:button`, `action:icon`, an `action:group` inline member) are wrapped by `DisabledReasonTrigger`: a `tabIndex={0}` span as the Radix trigger, and an `sr-only` copy that the button and the span both name in `aria-describedby`. This is objectui#11811's shape, with the key `actions.notAvailableForRecord` and its fallback.
  - `action:icon` puts its label above the reason inside the tooltip, because its own label tooltip cannot open while it is disabled. Its accessible name stays `aria-label`.
  - An authored `aria-describedby` is kept ahead of the reason (`describedByWithReason`).
  - Menu items (`action:menu`, an `action:group` dropdown member) get a visible second line. It is the item's description, and its name stays the label through `aria-labelledby`.
- **Brief readings, measured:**
  - Zone 2 #2: none of objectui#11811's three surfaces reads the legacy `enabled` key, so the reason follows the spec key `disabled` only, and `enabled: false` stays silent (pinned).
  - Zone 2 #3: a tooltip on a disabled Radix menu item is unreachable in Chromium (the hit target is the menu, and roving focus skips the item), so the visible line is the menu equivalent.
- **Reach, corrected:** the card named the showcase's `showcase_archive_task` as the producer. The dev measured that this specimen and `showcase_zoo_disabled_gate` are `record_header` / `record_section` actions, drawn by `page:header` and `record:quick_actions`, which objectui#11811 already fixed. These four renderers are reached through `action:bar` (the `ObjectView` and `InterfaceListPage` list toolbars, the `DetailView` header bar) and authored `action:*` nodes. The defect is real there, measured before the fix in Chromium: all five control kinds were disabled with no description, no tooltip and no keyboard reach. The PR's Acceptance notes record the correction.
- **Changeset sentences checked against the head:**
  - "It shows the reason "Not available for this record", the same generic sentence and the same language-pack key (`actions.notAvailableForRecord`)";
  - "the tooltip's trigger is a focusable wrapper around it … the icon's accessible name stays its label";
  - "The reason is a second line under the label. A tooltip there could not open";
  - "a control greyed out while its own action runs, a control the host disables … and an action disabled only through the legacy `enabled` key show no reason".
- **Reverse verification (dev report):**
  - Ablation A1, the hook returns `undefined`: 16 of 53 red, every positive pin red and every control green.
  - Ablation A2, the trigger returns the bare button: 12 red, the button-site pins red and the menu pins and controls green.
  - Both restored with the blob equal to HEAD.
  - The whole `packages/components/` suite at `01d1300`: 367 files, 3761 tests passed. The type-check exited 0.
- **Gates:** CI on `01d1300` (`head_sha` equals the PR head): 43 runs, 40 success, 3 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, its shard template, `dependabot`), 0 failure. `Lint` and `Type Check` are success. Mergeable state `clean`.
- **Contract review:** not required (`Clause-②: no`; no export, prop, type member or pack key).

Findings:
- objectstack's showcase comment on `ArchiveTaskAction` says the specimen exercises the `action:button` / `group` / `icon` / `menu` wiring, but its locations are drawn by `page:header` and `record:quick_actions`. That is stale prose in an example, not a filing class → `Acceptance notes`
- The wrapper is an `inline-flex` span, as in objectui#11811, so a full-width `action:button` would shrink to its content while the predicate holds. No such use was found in objectui sources or objectstack examples → `Acceptance notes`
- The `(action as any).disabled` casts that remain in `action-group.tsx` / `action-menu.tsx` are now unneeded. Polish → `dropped — no behaviour`

Landing: ready + auto-merge through the queue, now.
